start: A gym sent "Send delete request" from its admin app

steps.action: Open "Delete requests"
user_sees: Line "The privacy notice promises a delete within 30 days. Each step is written in the log."
Card under "New from the admin app" with the request text and a not-checked warning
must_not: The request hidden because it came from a desk login

steps.action: Press "Write it down for <gym name>"
user_sees: The request under "Open (1)": "Asked <date> · day 1 of 30 · 29 days left"
must_not: Two requests written for one admin-app message

steps.action: Press "I called the gym’s own number and the owner confirmed", then "I reminded them to download their data first"
user_sees: Both steps ticked with their times
must_not: A step ticked with no log line

steps.action: Type the gym code, press "Delete the gym for ever", confirm "Delete <gym> for ever? ... This cannot be undone."
user_sees: "Deleted <gym>. Checked <n> tables: nothing left. Pictures removed: <n>. Now tell the gym it is done."
must_not: Any row of the gym left in a gym table
Pictures of the gym left in storage while the note says the pictures were removed

start: A member erase asked by phone

steps.action: Under "Write down a request that came another way" pick the gym, "Erase one member", how to find them ("mobile ending 4321"), "By phone", the day, press "Write it down"
user_sees: An open card "erase a member: mobile ending 4321"
must_not: A member request saved with no way to find the member

steps.action: Press "I called the gym’s own number and the owner confirmed", erase by hand in support access, press "Done: the member is erased"
user_sees: The request under "Closed" as "done <date>"
must_not: "Delete the gym for ever" offered on a member request

start: An open gym request

steps.action: Type a wrong code and press "Delete the gym for ever"
user_sees: "That is not this gym’s code. Nothing was deleted."
must_not: Any row deleted

steps.action: Press delete before "Reminded" is ticked
user_sees: "First remind them to download their data and tick “Reminded”."
must_not: The gym deleted before the reminder

steps.action: Press delete with an HQ sign-in older than 15 minutes
user_sees: "For this, sign in again first (it must be within the last 15 minutes)."
must_not: The delete done on an old sign-in

start: An open request the gym no longer wants

steps.action: Type why, press "Cancel the request", confirm
user_sees: The request moves under "Closed (n)" as "cancelled <date>"
must_not: The cancel saved without a reason

steps.action: Press a step on a closed request from an old tab
user_sees: "That request is already closed."
must_not: A closed request reopened or the gym deleted

start: A gym just deleted

steps.action: Look at what stays
user_sees: HQ's request, log and access-log times keep the gym id and name; names and devices in the access log are emptied
must_not: Members, payments, check-ins, shop orders or pictures of the gym kept anywhere
The gym's web page photos left in storage

start: Admin app, Settings, Danger zone, gym online

steps.action: Press "Delete our gym from MettleUp"
user_sees: Sheet "Delete your gym from MettleUp?" with "Download your data first. Then we delete every member, payment, check-in and shop order of this gym from our server within 30 days, and call you on the gym’s number to confirm before we do. This cannot be undone."
must_not: Anything deleted at this tap

steps.action: Press "Send delete request"
user_sees: "Request sent. We will call you on the gym’s number before anything is deleted."
must_not: A success line when the message did not reach MettleUp

steps.action: Answer MettleUp's call on the gym's number and confirm; later try to sign in
user_sees: The gym is gone within 30 days; the admin app no longer opens it
must_not: A delete with no call to the gym's own number

start: The owner asks by email or phone instead of the app

steps.action: Email or call MettleUp asking to delete the gym
user_sees: MettleUp calls the gym's own number back before deleting
must_not: The request lost because it did not come from the app

start: A desk person, or a gym not online

steps.action: A front-desk login presses "Send delete request"
user_sees: The same sent line; HQ sees it as not checked
must_not: The gym deleted before MettleUp calls the owner on the gym's number

steps.action: A gym that is not online opens Danger zone
user_sees: No "Delete our gym from MettleUp" button
must_not: A request sent for a gym with nothing on the server

start: The owner changes their mind

steps.action: Tell MettleUp on the call that the gym wants to stay
user_sees: The request is cancelled; the gym keeps working
must_not: The gym deleted after the owner said no

steps.action: Send a new request later
user_sees: A new request is written down
must_not: The old cancelled request blocking a new one

start: The owner sent a delete request

steps.action: Read what the request carries
user_sees: Gym name, gym code, gym phone and who asked, sent only to MettleUp
must_not: The request text seen by members or other gyms

steps.action: After the delete
user_sees: Every member, payment, check-in and shop order of the gym deleted within 30 days
must_not: Gym records or photos still kept after 30 days

start: A member wants their details erased from the gym's records

steps.action: Ask MettleUp by email or phone, or through the gym
user_sees: MettleUp writes it down as "Erase one member"
must_not: The ask forgotten

steps.action: MettleUp calls the gym's own number, erases the member's details by hand, ticks "Done: the member is erased"
user_sees: The member's details gone from the gym's register; receipts stay as the law keeps them
must_not: The member still findable by name or mobile in the gym's register

start: The erase request written down with gaps

steps.action: HQ writes a member request with no way to find the member
user_sees: "Fill in every box."
must_not: A member request saved that nobody can act on

steps.action: HQ presses "Done: the member is erased" before calling
user_sees: "First call the gym’s own number and tick “Called”."
must_not: The request closed with the member not erased

start: The member's whole gym is deleted

steps.action: Open the member app after the gym delete
user_sees: The member keeps every workout and their history on the phone
must_not: The member's own workouts lost because the gym was deleted

start: A member erase in progress

steps.action: HQ opens support access to erase the member
user_sees: The look is recorded and the gym owner can see it
must_not: HQ seeing member names outside a recorded support window
